title: StarRocks backup: CREATE REPOSITORY + BACKUP/RESTORE SNAPSHOT
description: The nexus-cli backup verb for StarRocks: a REPOSITORY on the shared NFS mount (ADR-0032) + BACKUP SNAPSHOT (async) + RESTORE SNAPSHOT. StarRocks backup is async -- the verb polls SHOW BACKUP / SHOW RESTORE state until FINISHED. NFS-repo caveat: a Broker may be required; the clean path is MinIO/S3 at Phase 0.L (the verb surface is unchanged).

observe.what: the shared NFS backup repository is mounted from nexus-gateway on the FE + all BE

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql --skip-ssl -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u root -p$SR_ROOT_PW -e \"BACKUP SNAPSHOT nexus.snap_demo TO nexus_backups ON (events)\"; sleep 10; mysql --skip-ssl -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u root -p$SR_ROOT_PW -e 'SHOW BACKUP FROM nexus\G'"

observe.what: BACKUP SNAPSHOT runs async -- SHOW BACKUP State progresses SNAPSHOTING -> UPLOADING -> FINISHED (poll until FINISHED)

whatProves: backup/restore works through a cluster-shared repository (NFS from nexus-gateway, ADR-0032); the StarRocks async snapshot lifecycle is observable via SHOW BACKUP/RESTORE. Migrates to MinIO/S3 at 0.L without changing the verb.
